description.narrative: The programmatic approach consists of two subprograms sequenced to support the government in developing a sustainable market-oriented microfinance along the line with the Vietnam Microfinance Development Strategy, 2011-2020, focusing on the: (i) creation of a supportive policy and regulatory environment; (ii) enhancement of the supervisory and regulatory capacities; (iii) strengthening of microfinance involved financial institutions; and (iv) development of financial infrastructure. The proposed policy-based loan will support subprogram 2. The Country Partnership Strategy 2011-2015 of the Asian Development Bank (ADB) highlights the microfinance sector as a key area for ADB assistance.
